name: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.,Ltd.
summary: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells auto parts in China and internationally. The company offers air-conditioning pipelines, such as compressor suction and exhaust pipe, expansion valve inlet and outlet pipe, IHX pipe, and condenser connecting pipe assemblies; automotive heat exchange connecting tubes, including heater and oil cooling inlet and outlet pipes, and evaporator inlet pipes; automotive heat exchange accessories comprising filling valves, connectors, covers, flanges, brackets, and auto heat exchange accessories; and receiving drier products.
